pixel_observations.description: Five full-resolution frames of a portrait-oriented photograph of an ultrasound monitor, with black bars at the left and right. A header strip at the top edge carries partly cropped on-screen text that includes a calendar date and clock time and two capital letters at the upper right. A sector-shaped grayscale echo image with dark cavities and bright linear and curved structures fills the frame; a yellow letter V and a yellow depth marker 5 sit beside the sector. A green trace runs along the bottom, and a playback control strip with small text ending in fps is partly visible at the bottom edge. The arrangement of cavities and bright structures differs from frame to frame, and the image is grainy.
